input_references.role: Timestamped raw and matched-road trajectory points

metadata.goal: Analyze variations in travel efficiency across travel modes and trip distances.
metadata.category: Travel mode, distance, travel time, and short-trip exceptions
metadata.dataset_description: An independently constructed, road-aligned WorldTrace case containing 172 trajectories.

insight_list.insight: Car trips generally take less time than cycling trips over similar travel distances.

plot.title: Mode and Distance Travel Efficiency: Insight 1
plot.description: Question-specific evidence computed from the synchronized trajectory and point tables; the case-level route overview is retained separately.

insight_list.question: How does travel time compare between car and cycling trips over similar distances?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Compare mode-specific travel-time distributions within matched distance bands.

insight_list.insight: The travel-time difference between cycling and car trips increases with trip distance, but their overall route-directness ratios are similar and follow the same tendency as trip distance increases.

plot.title: Mode and Distance Travel Efficiency: Insight 2
plot.description: Question-specific evidence computed from the synchronized trajectory and point tables; the case-level route overview is retained separately.

insight_list.question: Does the cycling–car travel-time gap change with distance, and do the modes have similar route-directness patterns?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Compare the cycling-minus-car time gap and mode-specific route-directness ratios across distance bands.

insight_list.insight: A few short cycling trips have travel times comparable to similar car trips.

plot.title: Mode and Distance Travel Efficiency: Insight 3
plot.description: Question-specific evidence computed from the synchronized trajectory and point tables; the case-level route overview is retained separately.

insight_list.question: Are there short cycling trips whose travel times are comparable to car trips?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Inspect short-trip cycling exceptions against the regular short car distribution.

insights: Car trips generally take less time than cycling trips over similar travel distances.
The travel-time difference between cycling and car trips increases with trip distance, but their overall route-directness ratios are similar and follow the same tendency as trip distance increases.
A few short cycling trips have travel times comparable to similar car trips.
summary: Car trips generally take less time than cycling trips over similar travel distances. The travel-time difference between cycling and car trips increases with trip distance, but their overall route-directness ratios are similar and follow the same tendency as trip distance increases.
